subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB518
title: Authorizes a county tax collector to withhold from property tax distributions to taxing districts within the county an amount equal to three percent of the distributions.
headline: SB 518 did not pass

claims.text: SB 518 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 518 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
